sloka: ततः अब्रवीन् महा तेजा रामः लक्ष्मणम् अग्रतः ।स्थितम् प्राग् गामिनम् वीरम् याचमानम् कृत अन्जलिम् ॥२-३१-९॥
transliteration: tataḥ abravīn mahā tejā rāmaḥ lakṣmaṇam agrataḥ ।sthitam prāg gāminam vīram yācamānam kṛta anjalim ॥2-31-9॥

translations.english: Addressing the heroic Lakshmana in front of him imploring with folded hands to take him to the forest so that he may walk ahead (and guard them), the effulgent Rama said:
